title: Work and Play in Paris's Silicon Sentier
abstract: The area of central Paris around rue du Sentier, once home to part of the garment district, is now home to a hive of innovation.

title: Where to Go in La Brea, Los Angeles
abstract: The L.A. neighborhood has more than a dozen trendy new restaurants and boutiques selling home goods and fashions from up-and-coming designers.

title: Amish Country Embraces Farm-to-Table
abstract: Downtown Lancaster, Pa., long considered the nontouristy side of Amish Country, is embracing the farm-to-reclaimed-wood-table trend full tilt.
